item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["297b0f523028433cdf93"],"operation":"xmlXIncludeProcessNode processes the document URL in xmlXIncludeDoProcessRoot.","condition":"An injected allocation failure occurs while copying the document URL.","capability":"xmlXIncludeGetLastError(xinc) must expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure.","consequence":"The failure flag is set while xinc->errNo remains zero, so xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure aborts.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: its URL-copy failure condition differs from the reference-allocation condition of the other error-state candidate."},{"member_ids":["deba8e7bc4a7a32d9383"],"operation":"xmlXIncludeProcessNode expands xi:include and calls xmlXIncludeNewRef.","condition":"An injected allocation failure occurs at xmlXIncludeNewRef's xmlMalloc.","capability":"xmlXIncludeGetLastError must expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure.","consequence":"The failure flag is set while ctxt->errNo remains zero, so xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure aborts.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: its reference-allocation failure condition differs from the document-URL-copy condition."},{"member_ids":["3ba390c0559bc64579bd","fdbf5596cc669d801ca0"],"operation":"Configure an xmlXIncludeCtxt with xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler before xmlXIncludeProcessNode.","condition":"The entry creates an XInclude context but never installs its context-specific structured error handler and callback data.","capability":"Deliver XInclude errors and forward the configured callback and data to included XML parsing and XPointer evaluation.","consequence":"The context-specific structured callback behavior is unreachable for every fuzz input.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe the same missing xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler configuration, its error-forwarding capability, and its reachability consequence."}]}
